clips.title: The story
paras: Sprite Jumpsprocket needs a safer way to set off explosives, and Stormwind holds the answer. She sends you to Stormwind Intelligence for a remote detonator.

Sprite Jumpsprocket wants to set off explosives from a safe distance. Goblins and gnomes are known for handling volatile chemicals recklessly, but some blasts demand care. A standard fuse can put the person lighting it in danger. Sprite knows a controlled explosion needs a special trigger, the kind common tinkerers do not keep on hand.

Sprite sends you to Stormwind Intelligence in Old Town instead of to local dwarven blasters or ordinary engineering suppliers. The network is known as SI:7, and its covert agents handle sabotage, stealth, and targeted demolitions. Jasper Fel works among them in the capital and can provide discreet, dangerous equipment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.

paras: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?
